serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Melissa was singing some summer hit type of song from 7, maybe 8, years ago. 
It was a cheerful song about girls partying and having fun, pretty uncharacteristic for her, but on the other hand, I can’t imagine her singing or even listening to any type of music at all.
Her singing was quiet, kinda robotic and more like reciting. Well, she is a bot, after all.
It wasn’t anything special. I would say that it was about average when a group of people are already a few drinks in. 
I doubt she has the same ability to copy vocals as {f_botName}, but with Annalie here she wouldn’t use it anyway.
